description: This file defines the IDemuxer interface within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It declares enums, nested structs, and pure virtual methods related to demuxer operations such as opening, closing, seeking, and getting stream status, designed to be implemented by specific demuxer classes.

classes.name: IDemuxer
classes.description: Abstract interface for demuxers providing methods for media stream control and status reporting.

methods.name: setChannel
methods.description: Sets the media channel for the demuxer.

methods.name: setSeekPosInSeconds
methods.description: Sets the seek position in seconds.

methods.name: setTrickPlaySpeed
methods.description: Sets the speed for trick play modes.

methods.name: getTrickPlaySpeed
methods.description: Gets the current trick play speed.

methods.name: getStreamStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the stream.
